patch.value: Track the automated daily release for pm-ado

The daily release workflow opens a pull request carrying the generated changelog and release notes, and links this item so the release has a tracked record rather than only a commit. Publication to npm stays gated behind the PM_RELEASE_APPROVED repository variable until this repository is approved as carrying no private data anywhere in its history, which is the same rule pm-rl and pm-vcs follow as new packages.
